method: Every geometrically contiguous extrusion path (not split when only the slicer feature label changes); wholly sparse/gap-infill paths are excluded. Each remaining path is clipped against preceding-layer actual bead coverage expanded only 0.025 mm. Thus centerline needs approximately half bead support; side-connected unsupported portions are not ignored. Sparse infill is assessed as internal infill, not removable support. Whole-layer detached bead regions are checked separately.
